name: Club Legacy Soccer Manager [ALPHA]
desc:
⚽ Club Legacy: Soccer Manager ⚽

Build your football club. Lead your team. Write your legacy! 🏆

⭐ FEATURES ⭐
🛡️ Create and customize your club
🧠 Manage tactics and formations
📺 Watch live 3D matches
💎 Scout, sign and train players
🏆 Win titles and promotions
👥 Compete with friends and other managers
🌍 Climb global rankings

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get updates!

⚠️ ALPHA TEST ⚠️
Club Legacy is in early testing (alpha). You may find bugs and unfinished features.

products.name: Dream Team: 11 players + a 90 star + investor

llm.loop: create a football club -> sign, scout and train players -> set tactics -> watch simulated 3D matches -> win promotions up divisions
llm.objectives: take your club from Division 5 to Division 1 and climb global rankings
llm.progression: divisions, titles, squad quality, global rankings
llm.instructions: build your club, manage tactics and formations, scout and sign players
unique: football-manager style management sim on Roblox with live 3D match viewing
llm.thumbnails: Roblox footballers in striped kits, trophy celebration, 'DIV 5 -> DIV 1' progression, manager with tactics board
llm.complexity_notes: match simulation engine, 3D match rendering, transfer and management systems, rankings
